== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark) (Japanese Premiere Two-Player)|Death Star: Docking Bay 327 (Dark)]] from [[Premiere Introductory Two-Player Game (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.categoryonegames.com/catalog/star_wars_ccg-swccg_premiere_sw_2pg_japanese/death_star_docking_bay_327__darkside_japanese_white_border/50641 CategoryOneGames], [https://cc-client-assets.cdn.crystalcommerce.com/photo/categoryonegames/file/c44f3ecc34fb413fb71f858d35074b43/IMG_20220607_0116.jpg source photograph].

Crop rectangle <code>(6, 4, 1078, 772)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>71525237fad8a9fa582f247d4e601fc449c8bc687003caf9cfca6731a91a1da8</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.
